about: The line under a thread's root that counts its replies, saying what the channel says under that message, from the first frame the thread opens. count is the root's own reply count, as the channel shows it. replies lists the replies the thread holds so far, each sent, sending (this device's, not yet taken by the server), failed or deleted. The line counts whichever is larger, the root's count or the replies held that haven't failed and aren't deleted, so a reply still sending adds one, and a reply the root's count already includes isn't counted twice. divider is the line's words, and null for no line.

cases.name: A thread opens with the count the channel shows, before its replies load
A first reply still sending brings its line with it
A first reply stays counted once the server has it, before the root's count catches up
A reply the root's count already includes counts once
A reply still sending adds one
Only a failed reply means no line
The root's count includes replies the thread hasn't loaded
A deleted reply isn't a reply, as the server's count leaves it out
Only a deleted reply means no line
